title: 掠过黑洞时看见的扭曲星空
posterHook: 从遥远星海靠近，看光被拉成灿烂圆环；越过最近点，再回头看它缩成一粒金色星光。
question: 如果从深空掠过黑洞，你会看见怎样的宇宙？

en.title: The distorted sky seen on a black-hole flyby
en.posterTitle: The sky on a flyby past a black hole
en.posterHook: Approach through a sea of stars, hover by a blazing ring, then fly past and watch the black hole recede to a golden point.
en.question: What would the universe look like on a flyby past a black hole?
